subject.title: Slug alias quota (25) blocking legitimate naming migration — publisher nitishgargiitd

question: For this verified publisher migration, should ClawHub grant a one-time scoped alias exception, or require selected old redirects to be released before the remaining renames proceed?
rationale: The choice balances a legitimate account-specific migration against the product policy that preserves historical slugs to prevent squatting; repository evidence does not define a safe automatic threshold or approval rule.

options.title: Grant a scoped migration exception
options.body: After account verification, permit only the listed remaining aliases with an audit record while leaving the global quota unchanged.

options.title: Release selected old redirects first
options.body: Require the publisher to identify aliases safe to retire, then use those freed slots for the remaining renames.

recommendation.title: Grant a scoped migration exception
recommendation.body: After account verification, permit only the listed remaining aliases with an audit record while leaving the global quota unchanged.
